answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 64608 Country: India Title: Correct method of slaughtering an animal Question: I would like to know correct method of zibah. And the methods used by the butchers these days of just slicing chicken and dropping chicken in a drum in which it jumps too much. Are these methods correct t in Islam? Answer ID: 64608 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 665/804/SN=09/1437) While slaughtering, the animal should be laid down at its left side facing Qiblah and the slaughterer should put his right leg over its shoulder and slaughter it with sharp knife. It is necessary that at least any three of the four veins: windpipe (throat), food-tract (oesophagus) and the two jugular veins, are cut otherwise it shall not be halal. Whereas while slaughtering the chicken etc the slaughterer should turn towards Qiblah as well as the animal should also face Qiblah. However, the butcher puts the chicken in the drum after slaughtering only for the reason that the soul departs soon as it departs easily when left loose in contrary to holding it. Hence there is no harm in it. ومنها أن يكون الذابح مستقبل القبلة والذبيحة موجهة إلى القبلة (بدائع الصنائع 4/188، ط: زكريا) وحل يقطع أي ثلاث منها الدر المختار على رد المحتار ، 9/426، ط: زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
